description: Standardized input schema for all Script Prompt SKILL.md files. Replaces legacy {content_idea} + {Conscious_Soul_Values} with 8 mandatory structured inputs and 3 optional enrichment inputs gated by data phase.

structural_congruence_point.description: The seed — where coach and audience maps overlap. Contains the exact coordinates of structural resonance.

schema.trigger_expression_angle: string — which facet of the coach's activated position this blueprint expresses
schema.audience_foundation_violated: string — MFT foundation the audience resonates with
schema.congruence_description: string — human-readable description of the overlap
schema.seed_esk_anchors: list[string] — Emotionally Significant Keywords from the coach's authenticated material

voice_dna_spr.description: 3-layer Sparse Priming Representation of the coach's voice. L1 = construction mechanics (sentence skeletons, discourse marker positions, rhythm patterns). L2 = emotional path (how the coach travels from activation to expression). L3 = leadership elevation (peak expression of specific Attractive Leader Traits).

layer_2_emotional_path.activation_to_expression_sequence: list[string] — ordered steps the coach takes
layer_2_emotional_path.recovery_pattern: string — how the coach returns from peak

layer_3_leadership_elevation.ttt_ceiling: string — maximum TTT level this coach can authentically reach
layer_3_leadership_elevation.elevation_trigger: string — what activates the peak expression

emotional_dna.replaces: Not present in any legacy prompt
emotional_dna.description: 10-variable Emotional DNA profile. The appraisal mechanics that differentiate THIS coach from EVERY OTHER coach in the same domain.

schema.coping_potential_pattern: string — how the coach processes threat to resolution
schema.norm_compatibility_threshold: float — how far from norm before activation
schema.trigger_specificity_threshold: float — how specific vs. broad the coach's triggers are
schema.dominant_moral_position: string — the coach's default moral stance
schema.activation_intensity: float — 0-1 scale of emotional intensity when triggered
schema.vulnerability_window: string — when the coach's guard drops
schema.dual_layer_frequency: float — how often both encoding + PTG activate simultaneously

negative_space.replaces: Not present in any legacy prompt
negative_space.description: What the coach must NOT produce. Loaded BEFORE positive DNA in every prompt. Contains vocabulary, tonal registers, rhetorical moves, and identity edges this coach would never cross.
negative_space.loading_order: FIRST — before any positive DNA injection

schema.forbidden_vocabulary: list[string] — words this coach never uses
schema.forbidden_rhetorical_moves: list[string] — persuasion patterns that violate the coach's identity
schema.identity_edges: list[string] — boundaries the coach's content must never cross
schema.anti_patterns: list[string] — content structures that feel inauthentic to this coach

audience_tribal_terms.replaces: Not present in any legacy prompt
audience_tribal_terms.description: The audience's exact in-group vocabulary. Minimum 3 verified terms per content piece. These carry the sub-cortical recognition signal (Clark & Brennan, 1991).

schema.term_contexts: dict[string, string] — term → usage context mapping
schema.generation_markers: list[string] — generational/cultural markers specific to this tribe
schema.enemy_labels: list[string] — what the tribe calls their adversaries

authentication_certificate.replaces: Not present in any legacy prompt
authentication_certificate.description: LIWC composite score + per-marker breakdown + dual-layer activation flag. Gates generation fidelity: high-scoring material gets maximum preservation; low-scoring material gets standard voice replication.

schema.dual_layer_activation_detected: boolean — both original encoding + PTG path active
schema.trigger_id: string — which trigger was activated in this segment

fidelity_gates.high_fidelity: composite > 0.7 AND dual_layer = true → preserve ≥80% verbatim construction
fidelity_gates.re_elicitation: composite < 0.4 → flag for re-elicitation, do not force generation

archetype_metadata.description: Fully resolved archetype metadata including framework binding, visual category, persuasive angles, and TTT gravity palette.

schema.persuasive_angles: list[object] — resolved angle objects with operational_instruction + construction_constraint
schema.format_compatibility: list[string] — which output formats this archetype supports (video_note, carousel, thread)

context_premise_summary.replaces: Not present in any legacy prompt
context_premise_summary.description: Aggregated audience profile from the Context Premise Engine. Contains the audience's psychological coordinates that the content must address.

schema.dominant_moral_foundation: string — MFT foundation with highest activation
schema.mft_vector: dict[string, float] — all 6 foundations with weights
schema.hermeneutical_gap_score: float — 0-1, how much unarticulated experience exists
schema.sample_size: int — number of audience texts analyzed

optional_enrichment_inputs._gate: Only populated in HOT data phase (>50 audience texts). COLD and WARM phases receive null.

audience_reconsolidation_sensitivity.description: Average prediction error sensitivity across the audience cohort. High values = audience is primed for schema challenges.

audience_authenticity_distribution.description: Distribution of L-depth classifications across the cohort (% L1, % L2, % L3). Informs whether content should target performative or authentic registers.

intersection_score.description: Overall structural congruence between coach and audience. Higher = more confidence in the content direction.

loading_sequence: 2. authentication_certificate (gates fidelity level for remaining inputs)
3. structural_congruence_point (the seed — what we're building from)
5. emotional_dna (the root system — why we're building this way)

deprecated_inputs.{character_lexicon}: Consumed only by Art Director, not Script Prompts
